Creation of the Award.
Heroism is hereby established.
The Sajid Bulig Presidential Award for

Objectives of the Awards. The primary objective of the Sajid Bulig
Presidential Award, herein referred to as the Award, is to accord official recognition to an
individual who has demonstrated exemplary courage in the service of humanity, even at
the cost ofhis/her life. Specifically, the Award seeks to:
Confer distinct recognition to an individual who risked his/her life in the service of
the community, nation and humanity;
Reward individuals for exemplary deeds, outstanding feats or acts of heroism; and
Glorify examplars of the virtues of courage, selflessness, gallantry, bravery, and
Datriotism worthy of emulation by all Filipinos.

Funding.

Awards and Prizes. The Sajid Bulig Presidential Awardee shall receive a
special Plaque of Commendation and other prizes as may be determined by the National
Screening Committee.

Conferment of the Award. The President shall confer the Award to a
selected Awardee. The Award may be conferred posthumously, on behalf of the deceased
Awardee, to his/her legal heir or nearest of kin.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
